notes_for_editor: Moderate evidence. Lighthouse Friends (copyright) paraphrased; 1838 inspection, McDougall's stair complaint, 1867 lens, 1871-74 and 1930s dates rest on it alone. NRHP nomination PDF not digitised. Light-House Board reports before 1891 are not in the corpus, so the 1875-82 replacement request is second-hand. Footnote 2 and 14 both cite Port Huron Museums. Corpus grep found no wreck or rescue tied to the station. Kimball's Port Austin Reef service (1883-94) not included as no checked source cites it. Newspaper search (newspapers.py) did not return in time; no newspaper used. 1895 report fiscal year not pinned; text avoids a calendar year for the 205 hours. Checker 2026-10-22: roster expanded to the full USLHS list (cite 7); Kimball's Port Austin Reef service added from Lighthouse Friends (cite 4). Lighthouse Friends dates the 1913 storm 9-11 November, the Bulletin 8-10; the story follows the Bulletin.
